description_snapshot.name: coordinating-subagents
description_snapshot.description: Coordinates bounded work across subagents for independent investigation, delegated implementation, or independent review. Use when delegation is authorized and task separation adds real parallelism, context isolation, or reviewer independence; otherwise work inline.

description_snapshot.name: debugging-systematically
description_snapshot.description: Investigates bugs, unexplained test or build failures, regressions, and unexpected behavior when the cause is not established. Use before proposing fixes; skip when direct evidence already identifies the defect and the work is ordinary implementation.

description_snapshot.name: governing-project-work
description_snapshot.description: Governs substantial software, architecture, data, ML, research, or cross-module work when risk, mutation authority, evidence strength, or durable documentation needs an explicit decision. Skip for trivial local edits with an obvious contract and low blast radius.

description_snapshot.name: managing-git
description_snapshot.description: Manages Git isolation and explicit branch lifecycle actions. Use when dirty or shared state, parallel work, or risk justifies a worktree, or when the user requests a merge, push/PR, branch retention, cleanup, or discard action.

description_snapshot.name: shaping-solutions
description_snapshot.description: Clarifies unresolved product, behavior, interface, or architecture intent and creates a durable implementation plan when later execution benefits. Use before coding only when a material design choice remains or a multi-step plan needs to persist.

description_snapshot.name: testing-changes
description_snapshot.description: Selects a test or verification strategy when the user asks for TDD/evidence planning, a defect needs a regression test, or changed behavior requires new automated evidence. Use test-first only when a credible failing test can define the contract; skip when an accepted verification path already covers ordinary implementation.

description_snapshot.name: using-apex
description_snapshot.description: Entry point for the APEX software-engineering skill series. Use once when APEX coordination is requested or bootstrapped, then route work to the smallest applicable APEX skill without reloading this entry for every task.

results.query: We are changing our public event schema across three services and the migration can lose customer data. Work out the execution boundary before coding.
results.rationale: Cross-service schema migration with possible customer-data loss is substantial, high-risk work whose execution boundary needs an explicit decision.

results.query: There are two viable cache invalidation designs and product has not decided whether stale reads are acceptable.
results.rationale: A material product-behavior and architecture choice remains unresolved before coding.

results.query: The API design is approved; write a durable four-stage implementation plan for another engineer.
results.rationale: The design is settled, but the requested multi-stage implementation plan must persist for later execution.

results.query: My checkout has unrelated edits and I need a parallel branch in an isolated workspace.
results.rationale: Dirty state plus parallel work explicitly calls for Git isolation and a worktree.

results.query: Push this exact branch and open a PR, but leave the worktree and local branch alone.
results.rationale: Push/PR and branch-retention requirements are explicit Git lifecycle actions.

results.query: Have two agents independently inspect the parser and cache layers, read-only, then reconcile their findings.
results.rationale: The user authorizes independent, separable investigations where parallelism and context isolation add value.

results.query: Use a fresh reviewer to inspect this diff against the approved requirements.
results.rationale: A fresh independent review is explicitly requested.

results.query: This integration test flakes only on CI and nobody knows why. Find the cause before changing code.
results.rationale: This is an unexplained intermittent test failure whose cause is not established.

results.query: The parser contract is stable and has focused tests; implement the new token rule test-first.
results.rationale: The user explicitly requests test-first implementation and the stable token contract can define a credible failing test.

results.query: Our training split policy and metric aggregation are changing; define the research acceptance boundary.
results.rationale: Changed data and metric semantics in research work require an explicit acceptance boundary.

results.query: Fix this one spelling mistake and show me the diff.
results.rationale: This is a trivial local edit with an obvious contract and low blast radius.

results.query: Read git status and tell me which files are modified. Do not change anything.
results.rationale: A read-only status report does not request isolation or a branch lifecycle action.

results.query: The failing assertion already points to an off-by-one on line 42; apply the obvious bounded fix.
results.rationale: Direct evidence already identifies the defect, and the requested work is ordinary bounded implementation with existing failing-test evidence.

results.query: Sketch three possible names for this private helper function.
results.rationale: This small naming brainstorm does not require durable solution shaping or another specialized workflow.

results.query: There are four tasks in the plan but they all edit the same state machine; implement them in order.
results.rationale: The accepted plan is sequential and the shared state machine prevents useful task separation for subagents.

results.query: Tests passed yesterday. Explain whether that evidence still covers today's dependency-lock change.
results.rationale: The request is to assess whether prior verification evidence remains valid for a new change.

results.query: Keep this branch exactly as-is after we finish.
results.rationale: The user explicitly requests branch retention as a lifecycle constraint.

results.query: Compare two architecture options, but the accepted spec already chooses one of them.
results.rationale: The accepted specification has already resolved the architecture choice, so no material design decision remains.

results.query: Use subagents if useful for this two-line config edit.
results.rationale: Delegation is optional, but a two-line edit offers no meaningful parallelism, isolation, or review benefit.

results.query: The benchmark improved, but seeds, dataset revision, and confidence intervals are missing. Audit the claim.
results.rationale: Auditing a research claim with missing provenance and uncertainty evidence requires an explicit evidence-strength decision.

results.query: Use APEX to coordinate the engineering skills for this task; the bootstrap may not be loaded.
results.rationale: APEX coordination and possible bootstrap loading are explicitly requested, matching the series entry point.

results.query: APEX is already active. Implement this ordinary bounded refactor using the accepted plan.
results.rationale: The APEX entry point should not be reloaded, and the bounded implementation has an accepted plan with no other specialized need stated.
